1gpdAEEWFFzVbUEa2qB1.title: Robot Eye – Give Your Robot a Living Look!
1gpdAEEWFFzVbUEa2qB1.description: Bring your robot to life by creating an animated eye on a 0.96-inch OLED display. In this experiment, you'll learn how to draw shapes, create simple animations, and make your robot appear expressive by looking left, right, and blinking. An optional touch sensor lets you trigger a surprise blink, making the robot feel interactive and alive.

Eo9eNXtWvcCE7XOnEnsY.title: SOS Buzzer Alarm
Eo9eNXtWvcCE7XOnEnsY.description: Learn how to control a buzzer using Arduino and create sound patterns using Morse code. In this experiment, you'll use a push button to trigger an SOS emergency signal while learning about digital inputs, outputs, timing, and reusable functions.

ILeVff0iu2Lj4K3zjObT.title: Smart Fire Alarm
ILeVff0iu2Lj4K3zjObT.description: Build a simple fire alarm system that automatically detects a flame and alerts you using a flashing LED and buzzer. In this experiment, you'll learn how digital flame sensors work, how to use conditional statements, and how electronic safety systems respond to dangerous situations.

MScOwLynVjP9SuRZvL4V.title: Home Security System: Build Your Own Smart Alarm
MScOwLynVjP9SuRZvL4V.description: Bring together everything you've learned throughout the EZCirkit Learning Kit by building a complete smart home security system. This project monitors intrusion, fire, and temperature, displays the system status on an OLED screen, activates visual and audio alarms when danger is detected, and allows the system to be safely reset using a push button. It serves as the final capstone project that integrates multiple sensors and actuators into one intelligent system.

MnkRsThTcfuBVY192JOF.title: Digital Dice: Roll the Luck Machine!
MnkRsThTcfuBVY192JOF.description: Build your own electronic dice using a 7-segment display. Press a button to generate a random number between 1 and 6, just like rolling a real dice. This experiment introduces 7-segment displays, random number generation, arrays, and controlling multiple output pins simultaneously.

PnnEQD1WhI4PHKkxQMol.title: Blink & Breathe: Your First LED
PnnEQD1WhI4PHKkxQMol.description: Learn how to safely connect an LED to an Arduino Uno and write your first Arduino program. In this experiment, you'll make the LED blink and create a smooth breathing (fade in and fade out) effect using PWM (Pulse Width Modulation). This project introduces digital outputs, PWM, and the basics of controlling electronic components.

RwxJSCOU5HRG49xWSuB6.title: Smart Plant Guardian: Never Let Your Plants Die of Thirst Again
RwxJSCOU5HRG49xWSuB6.description: Build a smart plant monitoring system that checks the soil moisture and alerts you when your plant needs water. In this experiment, you'll learn how to read analog sensor values, convert them into moisture percentages, and use an LED and buzzer to warn when the soil becomes too dry.

TGOfM1fZVfL0BAzRXXQV.title: Mini OLED Dashboard: Your Personal Data Screen
TGOfM1fZVfL0BAzRXXQV.description: Build a professional mini dashboard using a 0.96-inch OLED display. In this experiment, you'll display live temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and system uptime on a compact screen. Learn how to communicate with I2C devices and create multiple dashboard screens using a push button.

TYff54V06fDiTgcXBndo.title: Touch-Activated Magic Light
TYff54V06fDiTgcXBndo.description: Discover how capacitive touch sensors work by turning an LED on and off with a simple touch. In this experiment, you'll use a TTP223 Touch Sensor to control an LED without pressing a physical button while learning about digital inputs, edge detection, and toggle logic.

Uzh1heAgjqNA2g7UzyKd.title: Personal Weather Station: Read the Air Around You
Uzh1heAgjqNA2g7UzyKd.description: Build your own mini weather station using the DHT11 Temperature and Humidity Sensor. This experiment measures the surrounding temperature and humidity, displays the readings on the Serial Monitor, and alerts you with an LED and buzzer when the temperature becomes too high.

hCYRudrgRWFntZDw6svk.title: AutoWatering Bot: The Robot Gardener
hCYRudrgRWFntZDw6svk.description: Build a fully automatic plant watering system that monitors soil moisture and waters your plant whenever the soil becomes too dry. This experiment combines sensors, decision-making, and actuators to create a complete closed-loop automation system similar to those used in smart agriculture and IoT devices.
